en: Dip your hands into the water.
Beseeching the holy ones,
Perform the washing of your hands!
My precious foal,
Turn over the black turf.
Saying, ‘Leopard Manas, give me your aid,’
Overturn it toward the north!
If water wells abundantly from within,
It means God has granted us favor.
If there is no water within—
Oh, Kanykei, my foal,
It means God has struck us down!
For the only child, growing capable,
Kanykei, let us try casting an omen.
If your omen does not come true,
Following your lord Manas,
My child, let us both die together!”
Thus she spoke,
The elder woman, like a lord,
Now gave her words of divination.
Ah, the lord's wife Kanykei
Sprang up from her place.
Draping the gray belt firmly about her neck,
Her betrothed, Sultan Manas—
She beseeched his spirit.
“O God, set my affairs right!” she said.
She dipped her hands into the water,
Performed the washing of her hands,
And dipped her feet into the water.
